label: Rematch — the mirror answers

recentEvents.value: The Continuance returned him; so did the lesson. He has been practicing in the mirror-gallery.
He greeted the gate-bell with the intruder's own words — 'Have at you, foul evil!' — and then apologized to his court for how natural it sounded.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He is becoming a copy of the thing destroying his court — and he has begun to catch himself admiring the technique.

temporaryObjective.value: End the duel with the intruder's own techniques before the court learns them by watching him.

notes: ESCALATION-BY-MIMICRY (required): he learns violence by copying the hero — kit, cadence, and now the hero's own heroic clichés, always with a beat of self-awareness: 'Forgive me. I heard it so many times it began to sound like language.'
